questions.question: Who wrote Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, and travels with a case full of creatures?
questions.note: A magizoologist. The case is bigger on the inside, with habitats for the animals.

questions.question: What creature stuffs shiny things into a pouch on its belly?
questions.note: Newt's niffler keeps escaping in New York and robbing jewelry stores and bank vaults.

questions.question: What do American witches and wizards call a non-magical person?
questions.note: Short for No Magic. British wizards say Muggle. Jacob Kowalski is a No-Maj.

questions.question: What is the American wizarding government called?
questions.note: Magical Congress of the United States of America. In the first film it is based in New York.

questions.question: What No-Maj baker becomes Newt's friend in New York?
questions.note: He wants his own bakery. He gets swept into Newt's case and can see the creatures. Queenie likes him.

questions.question: What dark force grows inside Credence Barebone because he was forced to hide his magic?
questions.note: The child who carries one is an Obscurial. Credence was raised by Mary Lou Barebone, who hunts witches.

questions.question: Who is Percival Graves revealed to be at the end of the first Fantastic Beasts film?
questions.note: He has been hunting Credence while wearing another man's face. Newt exposes him in the subway.

questions.question: In what city is the first Fantastic Beasts film set?
questions.note: 1926. The sequel moves to Paris. The third film's election is held in Bhutan.

questions.question: Which Goldstein sister can hear other people's thoughts?
questions.note: She is a natural Legilimens. Tina, her sister, is an Auror who arrests Newt when his creatures get loose.

questions.question: What object stops Dumbledore from moving against Grindelwald for years?
questions.note: They swore it when they were young. A pendant holds the pact. It is broken in The Secrets of Dumbledore.
